_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); railroad signals

pit_profile.why: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not

classification.quality_note: Union Pacific: the largest railroad in North America, covering 23 states across the western two-thirds of the US, with BNSF its main rail competitor on parallel routes; carload volume follows the industrial economy, the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 2.56x; +57% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.95; conservative 2yr -16%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -17.4%/yr (worst year FY06-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-4.5%/yr (Q3 2016 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.8%/yr (FY06-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +34.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: UNP (retrospective, 2016-12-30) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 2.56x (52.7% downside to Bear $49 / +20.6% upside to Bull $125) | Adj composite 1.25 vs market 3.20: gap -1.95 [OVERVALUED] | +57% above the EPP floor $66 (12x FY16E $5.49) | Conservative 2-yr case: -15.8% total (-7.9%/yr) | At 18.9x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $137 sits above the BULL case; carloads -6% in Q3 2016, forward revenue -7% (no FY16 revenue guide, Q3 2016 freight revenue); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
